name: WooSarr
description: Grants and removes Plex library access based on Discord roles. Map each Discord role to Plex libraries; linked members get every library their roles give, and losing a role only removes a library if nothing else keeps it. Members link their own Plex account with the Discord bot (/link, verified by signing in with Plex); families can share one Plex account. Per-library exemptions, manual grants, impact previews, dry-run until you turn it off, and a full audit trail. The bot also sends Plex invites (/invite), runs reaction posts that give roles, and takes movie and TV requests through Seerr (/request). Web UI on port 31337 with alerts, logs and optional single sign-on.
